name: EIA-860M Monthly Electric Generator Inventory
proves: Preliminary utility-scale operating, planned, and retired electric generators (typically >= 1 MW) with plant IDs, nameplate MW, fuel, technology, and planned/retirement dates.
does_not_prove: Not available data center IT load, not an interconnection commitment, and not a complete backup-generator inventory.

name: EIA-861 Utility Service Territory
proves: County-level reported electric utility service territories by utility number, name, state, and data year.
does_not_prove: Utility candidate only; does not prove parcel-level serviceability, feeder availability, or committed MW.

name: PJM Load Forecast Report Tables (B9 / B9b)
proves: Regional zone and RTO load forecast adjustments above embedded summer peak load (Table B9) and total load associated with summer peak adjustments (Table B9b).
does_not_prove: Regional forecast adjustments only; not site-level committed MW and not exclusively data center load. Do not add B9 and B9b together.

name: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) API
proves: Legal entity name, LEI, registration status, jurisdiction, and registered/headquarters addresses for entities that hold an LEI.
does_not_prove: Does not prove site ownership, project sponsorship, or operating tenant for a specific parcel or permit.

name: US Census Incorporated Places Population Estimates
proves: Official state and place FIPS codes and annual population estimates for incorporated US cities and towns.
does_not_prove: Excludes census-designated places and unincorporated county areas; gives no parcel coordinates or infrastructure availability.

name: Texas TDLR TABS (Architectural Barriers Project Search)
proves: Registered Texas construction projects with project ID, facility name, location, registration date, proposed start/completion dates, reported cost, square footage, owner, and design firm.
does_not_prove: Registration and accessibility review status only; does not prove groundbreaking, active construction, or completion.

name: Maryland MDE Frederick Data Center Document Index
proves: Public index of Maryland Department of the Environment filings and permit documents tied to Frederick County data center projects.
does_not_prove: A listed filing title is not an approved permit or active construction stage; read the underlying document.

name: Oklahoma DEQ Information on Data Centers (Air & Water Permits)
proves: Public Air and Water permit rows listing division, county, company, facility, permit type, and permit status (ISSUED, PENDING, REVIEW).
does_not_prove: Includes associated power facilities, excludes construction stormwater, and permit status is not construction stage.

name: Minnesota PUC Data Center Electric Service Agreements (ESAs)
proves: Public Commission docket numbers, utility/customer/city filing records, and public-comment links for large-load electric service agreements.
does_not_prove: A filed docket or review notice does not prove Commission approval, effective date, construction start, or energized MW.
